reason: I already pay every month for a big fitness app that has a postpartum plan, so I don't need another one. I might try the free 5 weeks out of curiosity, but that's 5 weeks of free stuff before I'd even think about paying, and I'd probably stop there.
objection: 45 minutes a day doesn't fit when the baby only naps 30 to 60 minutes. My app already does shorter sessions, so I can't see what the $19.99 gets me that I'm not already paying for.
would_change_my_mind: If my GP or physio pointed me to it for my diastasis because it does more than my current app's postpartum plan, with shorter 20-minute sessions I could actually finish during a nap.
